name: fome-mc PSU block, rung-2 power reference (AGENTEE-106)
scope: Captured fome-mc psu.kicad_sch at df304f3 without the CAN transceivers (31 parts), on an original standalone board: J1 supplies /12V_RAW and GND, J2 exposes the protected and regulated rails, J3 the CAN buses, and an mcu stub the power-good and CAN logic nets. Judge the block against the captured DESIGN.md section 6.3 and BLOCK_LIBRARY.md power supply entry: input protection, reverse-battery block, LMR16020 buck, TLS115D0E sensor supplies, TLV757P 3.3 V LDO and capacitor selection. No layout is captured.
limitations: Checks of kinds datasheet_limits, active_model, catalog_part_identity and catalog_rating are not registered; they are declared so the requirements they serve are recorded as unknown coverage (AGENTEE-18, 19, 27, 29, 61, 137).
rc_transient models passive-only networks; the PSU sheet has active parts, so the L1/C6 filter check is expected to be unsupported.
No datasheet, catalog snapshot or layout is captured. The saved board is empty.
The block entry is a draft: boundary voltage domains and currents are undeclared owner facts, and parts.json is a draft listing.

requirements.statement: The captured block sheets load natively, pass ERC and export a native netlist in which every reference-set component is present.

Every reference-set terminal on a net that leaves the block stays on the named native net, and every reference-set component keeps its populated state and value, as in the captured interface contract.

source.locator: Block catalogue / Power supply (psu.kicad_sch, without CAN)

requirements.statement: D1 (SMCJ24A, LCSC C224045, unidirectional, cathode on /12V_RAW, anode on GND) clamps positive load dumps and inductive transients on /12V_RAW below 38.9 V, under every downstream absolute maximum: Q1 AO4485 40 V, TLE9201SG 40 V, B340A 40 V, VNLD5090 42 V, DRV8825 45 V.

source.locator: 6.3 Power Supply, item 1, Sacrificial Crowbar TVS (D1 & D22 SMCJ24A, C224045)

requirements.statement: Q1 (AO4485 P-MOSFET, LCSC C51499; drain pins 5-8 on /12V_RAW, source pins 1-3 on /12V_PROT) with D19 (BZT52C12 gate-source Zener, C43491) and R124 (47k gate pull-down, C25819) blocks reverse battery without a series diode drop.

source.locator: 6.3 Power Supply, item 1, P-Channel MOSFET Reverse-Polarity Block (Q1 AO4485, C51499)

requirements.statement: C12, the +5V buck output capacitor, is the Murata GCM188R71C106KA64D 10 uF 16 V X7R 0603 (LCSC C3092605).

source.locator: 6.3 Power Supply, item 2, Hybrid-Polymer Bulk, 16 V X7R +5V Output & Soft-Terminated 50 V X7R MLCCs, C12

requirements.statement: C4, the 4.7 uF input RC damper on /12V_PROT via R2, is a 50 V X7R 1210 (Murata GCJ32ER71H475KA12L, LCSC C417122), rated above the 38.9 V SMCJ24A clamp.

source.locator: 6.3 Power Supply, item 2, Hybrid-Polymer Bulk, 16 V X7R +5V Output & Soft-Terminated 50 V X7R MLCCs, C4

requirements.statement: +3V3 stays regulated at 3.30 V until U3 (LMR16020PDDAR) reaches its 4.30 V minimum operating VIN, a guaranteed steady-state floor of about 4.80 V at the battery (4.30 V plus the ~0.50 V series path), with the LMR16020 EN UVLO falling at 4.50 V.

source.locator: 6.3 Power Supply, item 3, Reconciled U3 (LMR16020PDDAR) Cranking Brownout Margin (FOMEMC-17)

requirements.statement: +5V is 5.00 V within 2 % above 5.5 V input; 5V_SENSOR_1 and 5V_SENSOR_2 are 5.00 V within 1 %; +3V3 is 3.30 V within 1 %.

source.locator: Block catalogue / Power supply (psu.kicad_sch, without CAN), Requirements

requirements.statement: Every PSU capacitor is rated above the clamp voltage of its rail: C2, C5 (/12V_PROT), C7 (/VBOOST), C8 and C10 (U3 soft-start and bootstrap) are 50 V X7R, C6 is the 50 V hybrid polymer and C12 is 16 V on +5V.

source.locator: 6.3 Power Supply, item 2, Hybrid-Polymer Bulk, 16 V X7R +5V Output & Soft-Terminated 50 V X7R MLCCs

requirements.statement: /12V_PROT passes through the L1 (2.2 uH) + C6 (47 uF) LC filter directly into /VBOOST (U3 VIN).
